text.text_excerpt: Fantastic product!! I love this place. It has fresh fruit in everything they produce. It's a very refreshing alternative to all the unhealthy summertime treats you may have grown up on. The snoballs for instance. The make their with fresh fruit. They also have smoothies and fresh made juice. Definitely give this place a go. Especially if you're throwing a party. Instead of pumping your kids up with high fructose corn syrup snoballs, let these people hook you up with delicious fresh fruit snowballs!

Love, love love the smoothies here. Delicious and creative ideas (my current favorite being the 'Pine Street', a completely refreshing blend of pineapple, orange juice, and fresh mint) and friendly staff who are more than willing to accommodate any requests you may have regarding your order. All of the smoothies made with milk are made with soy milk, so vegans/vegetarians don't have to worry. Huge emphasis on fresh, there have actually been times where I've gone to the shop for a smoothie, only to find it closed momentarily while the owner is out getting more fresh fruit. My first time I ever came to New Orleans was a harried weekend spent searching for an apartment. Then I met the owner of Beacoup Nola who brought us over to the apartment above his shop and of course we had to try a snoball. The whirlwind craziness of the weekend melted away with my first bite. I think I may have forgotten where I was. That was my first snoball. A fluffy white mix of icy snow with fresh mango juice poured all over the top. Now, I can't stand any other snoballs. Really! I'm a New Orleander who can't stand the sticky overly sweet snoballs that are such an important part of the city's history. They're just gross. Beacoup, however, is different.
